description:
Get a company's fiscal calendar: every quarter it reported, with its own dates.

One row per quarter, oldest first, from the company's 10-K and 10-Q reports in
order: period_start is the day after the previous quarter's period end,
period_end the report's, fiscal_year and fiscal_quarter by position after the
previous annual report (Q4 is the 10-K), plus the quarter's length in months and
the report that closes it (form, filing_date, accession_number; its page is
beatandraise_base_url + accession_number). cover_fiscal_year /
cover_fiscal_period are what the filing's cover says, as filed (about 1% disagree,
flagged). latest_fiscal_year_end is the newest 10-K's period end.

Use it whenever a question names a fiscal period ("Apple Q1 FY2024", "Nvidia's
fiscal 2025", "Q4") to get the exact dates instead of guessing: fiscal years are
not calendar years (Medtronic's fiscal 2018 runs May 2017 to April 2018), and 52/53
week companies end on a weekday that moves every year (Apple's FY2023 ended
2023-09-30, FY2024 on 2024-09-28). Also to see which report covers a quarter, and
that Q4 has no 10-Q of its own: Q4 = the 10-K's year minus the Q3 10-Q's nine
months.

Irregular quarters are flagged, never corrected: irregular_quarter (not 3 months:
a missing 10-Q, or a company that files only 10-Ks, whose rows are years),
irregular_year, transition (10-KT/10-QT, a fiscal-year change), period_mismatch
(header_period and xbrl_period differ; period_end is the one the filing's figures
confirm), header_only (no XBRL, dates from the submission header, mostly before
2011), fy_mismatch / fp_mismatch, duplicate_report, amendment_only, first. 10-K/10-Q
filers only: a foreign filer (20-F, 40-F) has no quarterly calendar here.

Args:
    cik: Company CIK (e.g. "320193" for Apple; use search_companies to find it)
    fiscal_year: Only this fiscal year's quarters (e.g. 2024)
    from_date: Earliest period end (YYYY-MM-DD)
    to_date: Latest period end (YYYY-MM-DD)
    limit: The newest N quarters in the window, returned oldest first (1-400, default 40)
name: get_fiscal_calendar
title: Get Fiscal Calendar
